mathematics.assertion_tested: For 200 seeded four-binary-variable finite models, with propagation disabled and enabled and all other relation-search features enabled, the top four score/assignment pairs equal direct Cartesian enumeration and every exported hard nogood excludes no feasible assignment.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integer sums; finite extensional Boolean relations
mathematics.conventions: Lexical variable order a,b,c,d; score descending then full assignment lexicographically ascending; empty hard relation is inconsistent
inputs: 200 models generated by random.Random(316128); three relation tables, two integer factor tables per model
non_claims: Does not test product objectives, all option combinations or imported proofs
Finite tests do not prove an arbitrary-size algorithm
